admission.active_demand: Completed daily return >=5%, close location >=80%, turnover >=1.5x the strictly prior-20-session median, and close not locked at the upper limit
admission.confirmation: The next two exchange-session closes are both >= the active-demand close; all confirmation data are known at the second close
admission.first_event: No identical active-demand event for the same stock in the strictly previous 20 completed sessions
admission.industry_structural_bull: PIT members >=10; median ret20>0; positive-ret20 share>=55%; median ret60>0; positive-ret60 share>=50%, at both mother and confirmation closes
admission.market_structural_bull: Market median ret20>0 and positive-ret20 share>50%; median ret60>0 and positive-ret60 share>50%, at both mother and confirmation closes
admission.participation_cluster: At least 10 qualifying first active-demand mother events on the completed mother session
admission.relative_position: On the strictly previous completed session, stock industry-ret20 percentile <=50%
admission.stock_inventory_support: The active-demand close remains at or below the strictly prior-60-session high, and the strictly prior-20-session low is no lower than the prior-21-to-60-session low. Recent-versus-older turnover contraction is recorded descriptively but cannot substitute for price support.

economic_hypothesis: In a sustained broad and industry bull state, simultaneous first active-demand bars reveal capital diffusion. A previously non-leading constituent whose higher price is accepted for two completed sessions has undergone an observable demand-led inventory transfer rather than a one-day rebound.
entry: First legal daily open within three market sessions after the completed confirmation close

evidence_governance.post_observation_stability: 2021-2023; related aggregate predecessor outcomes were already observed, so not pristine validation
evidence_governance.post_2023_execution_data: Only to resolve positions signaled through 2023-12-31

independence: No downward-gap, true-gap, collapse-repair, quiet-platform, or V24 event identity is used
time_stop: H15 completed-session state, then next legal daily open
